entities.summary: Lias Andersson is a Swedish professional ice hockey forward for EHC Biel-Bienne of the National League (NL). He was selected in the first round, seventh overall, by the New York Rangers of the National Hockey League (NHL) in the 2017 NHL entry draft. Andersson has also previously played for the Los Angeles Kings.
